reason: At packages/core/EventManager.ts:118-119, `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` is undefined when destinationCalendar is null, undefined or an empty array. Calendar.d.ts:171 allows those values. `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` is then read without `?.`, so when evt.location is Google Meet it throws a TypeError instead of falling back to Daily. The old code used `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` and was safe.
